<h1 style="color:#F6F1E7">Learn Which Passengers Matter</h1>
<p style="color:#F6F1E7">A trained neural metric, supervised neighbors, and one new view for our foundation ensemble.</p>
<p style="color:#b9d6d5">Den Pugovkin · five frozen folds · no external model downloads</p></div>

Our previous reported **0.96183** plateau motivates a different learner. This notebook trains
a new **ModernNCA-inspired** model on the 21 raw survey fields, then gives its genuine OOF
predictions to the unchanged C=.003 logistic foundation: **201 → 202 views**.
The exp036 bounded correction is frozen. A new leaderboard record is a goal, not a measured result.

**GPU T4 x2 / one GPU used · Internet off · same 11 Inputs/privatev30 as v0.32.1.**
All five neural models are trained here. No pretrained TabPFN weights, FAISS, wheels or extra private upload.
The public one-model companion needs competition input only; this score runner also needs the nine public libraries.

import os,sys,json,hashlib,base64,zlib,zipfile,shutil
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
os.environ.setdefault('CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG', ':4096:8')
REMOTE = bool(os.environ.get('KAGGLE_KERNEL_RUN_TYPE') or os.environ.get('COLAB_RELEASE_TAG') or Path('/kaggle/input').exists())
RUN_TRAINING = REMOTE
if REMOTE:
    WORK = Path('/kaggle/working') if Path('/kaggle/input').exists() else Path('/content/work/playground-series-s6e10')
else:
    choices = [Path.cwd(), Path.cwd()/'competitions/predicting-airline-satisfaction', Path.cwd().parent]
    COMP = next(p for p in choices if (p/'competition.yaml').is_file() and (p/'src').is_dir())
    WORK = COMP/'artifacts/v33-local-preview'
print('Training enabled:', RUN_TRAINING, '| 5 new CUDA neighborhood fits + one fixed CPU stacker')

BLOB = ''
payload = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(BLOB))
assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == '1c07663ba959430fae6e8f871daa131facb0a501972115316a90d7fb87e673ea'
CODE = WORK / 'neighborhood-code-v0330'
for relative, source in json.loads(payload).items():
    path = Path(relative)
    assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
    destination = CODE / path
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.exists() and destination.read_text() != source:
        raise FileExistsError('Preserving another source snapshot; start a fresh session')
    destination.write_text(source)
sys.path.insert(0, str(CODE/'src'))
print('Verified source snapshot:', '1c07663ba959430fae6e8f871daa131facb0a501972115316a90d7fb87e673ea'[:16])

## 1 · Why this is a different model

[ModernNCA, ICLR2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.03257) learns a neural representation in which useful
training examples become neighbors. [TabR, ICLR2024](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/4ef594af0d9a519db8fb292452c461fa-Abstract-Conference.html)
independently demonstrates the value of retrieval for tabular prediction. We use an original adaptation:
learned periodic numeric features + category embeddings + a 64-dimensional metric, with a shared binary head.

Every training batch samples2048 training keys; its own row ID is masked. Loss is50% neighbor NLL +50% head BCE.
Prediction is the fixed50/50 mean of those two paths. Full validation/test inference streams **all outer-training keys**,
not validation/test labels. No quadratic full-dataset matrix or approximate index is created.
Training-only medians/IQR/vocabularies; 12 fixed epochs, no outer-fold stopping, no sweeps.
This is inspired by the papers, not a claim of reproducing their benchmark results or exact architecture.

from dataclasses import replace
from config import load_competition_config
from runtime import resolve_paths
from neighborhood_gpu import preflight
from neighborhood_model import PARAMS
CONFIG_PATH = CODE/'experiments/exp042/config.yaml'
cfg = load_competition_config(CONFIG_PATH)
paths = resolve_paths(cfg['competition']['slug'])
if not REMOTE:
    paths = replace(paths, competition_root=COMP, src_dir=CODE/'src', data_dir=COMP/'data/raw')
else:
    paths = replace(paths, src_dir=CODE/'src', competition_root=CODE)
public_root = None if REMOTE else COMP/'artifacts/research_v28_2026_10_13'
verified = preflight(cfg, paths, input_root=public_root)
display(pd.Series(PARAMS, name='One predeclared training preset'))
print('Preflight passed:', verified['data'].train.shape, verified['data'].test.shape)
print('Frozen v1 verified byte-for-byte; five folds, seed2036. New stack CV remains unknown.')

## 2 · Which correlations might a single linear summary miss?

The feature heatmap uses a seeded50k training sample. Rating–target correlations are also shown
inside business/personal travel, followed by the Wi-Fi × boarding table with cell counts.
These are descriptive relationships, not causal effects or a feature-selection loop.
We keep the predeclared complete21-field view. A learned metric can represent nonlinear interactions
even when one-dimensional correlation is small. Whether that helps is measured by OOF after training.

from neighborhood_diagnostics import raw_figures
raw_figures(verified['train'], verified['target'], WORK/'neighborhood-diagnostics')
del verified  # Release201-view matrices before the pipeline's own complete preflight.

## 3 · Train five new models, then refit202 views

`pipeline.run('exp042')` saves each completed fold: encoder, preprocessing context, predictions,
seeds, training history, source/environment fingerprints and ID scopes. A rerun resumes only
a complete matching fold; a changed checkpoint fails. No bank labels or raw training rows are exported.

New-model OOF AUC is valid development evidence on frozen v1. The final202-view stack still has
mixed external producer ancestry, so its independent CV is **null**. Do not present neural AUC as final-stack AUC.
The existing public0.96183 is not overwritten with a guessed score. Allow1–4h as an unmeasured planning budget;
exact full-bank inference can dominate runtime. One preset, no automatic CPU fallback.

result = None
if RUN_TRAINING:
    from pipeline import run
    result = run('exp042', config_path=CONFIG_PATH)
    display(pd.Series({'new_neighborhood_OOF_AUC':result['new_base']['overall_oof_auc'],
                       'new_head_OOF_AUC':result['new_base']['head_oof_auc'],
                       'new_neighbor_OOF_AUC':result['new_base']['neighbor_oof_auc'],
                       'final_stack_independent_CV':result['overall_oof_auc'],
                       'new_base_LR_coefficient':result['new_base_coefficient']}))
else:
    print('Local preview: no model fitting, GPU probes or training pipeline calls.')

## 4 · Does it make different mistakes?

Measured head/neighbor/hybrid AUCs use identical validation rows. **The mixture stays fixed**;
the chart does not select a better-looking arm. OOF error correlations compare y−prediction against
our four owned models on the same frozen v1. This differs from correlating two unlabeled test files.
A low correlation alone cannot rescue a weak model; inspect strength and complementarity together.

if result is not None:
    from neighborhood_diagnostics import result_figures
    output = paths.work_dir/'exp042'
    result_figures(output)
    display(pd.read_csv(output/'oof_correlations.csv'))

if result is not None:
    output = paths.work_dir/'exp042'
    assert hashlib.sha256((output/'submission.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == result['submission_sha256']
    shutil.copytree(CODE, output/'reproduction', dirs_exist_ok=True,
                    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.pyc'))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(paths.work_dir/'neighborhood_gpu_v33_results.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for path in sorted(output.rglob('*')):
            if path.is_file(): archive.write(path,path.relative_to(paths.work_dir))
    print('Submit:', paths.work_dir/'submission.csv')
    print('Download:', paths.work_dir/'neighborhood_gpu_v33_results.zip')
